diagram_previews.alt: Oblique drawing of a cube with hidden edges dashed, and one rotation axis of each kind: a red vertical axis through the centres of the top and bottom faces (labelled face), a blue axis along a long diagonal through two opposite vertices (labelled vertex), and a green axis through the midpoints of two opposite edges (labelled edge). Each axis is dashed inside the cube and solid outside.
